quote: Grenergy has closed a $268 million senior non-recourse financing agreement, including credit facilities, for the Monte Águila plant. The project has a solar capacity of 342 MW and 1,034 MWh of storage and is part of the Central Oasis platform, located in Chile.
note: Opened Grenergy English press; USD 268m senior NR financing / 342 MW + 1,034 MWh / ~USD 2bn Oasis financings cumulative confirmed.
